newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan gets 17 foreign ship orders in January.
newsitem.headline: Japan gets 17 foreign ship orders in January.

text.p: Japanese shipyards received 17 ship orders from foreign firms in January, totalling 528,030 gross registered tonnes (grt), down 0.4 percent from a year earlier, the Japan Ship Exporters" Association said on Tuesday.
Orders for January included seven freighters, six bulk carriers, three clean tankers and one very large crude carrier.
South Korea, the world's second-largest ship exporter after Japan, received orders for five vessels from foreign firms in January, totalling 230,500 grt, the association added.
